title: Crush *Cancer.*
subtitle: Wearable art by the King of Pop Art, made with Il Mano Gallery for the PHASE ONE Gala 2026.
concept: Nelson De La Nuez, the King of Pop Art, joined Il Mano Gallery to make a one-of-a-kind wearable piece for PHASE ONE: his iconic French Bulldog, carrying a message we can all stand behind.
process: The handprint on the front is the artist's own, applied by hand. Tap the sleeve and an embedded NFC tag opens the film of him placing it.
quote: His iconic French Bulldog on the back. His actual handprint on the front, placed by his own hand.

views.label: Back
views.alt: Back of the white hoodie: Nelson De La Nuez's blue French Bulldog under red and black CRUSH CANCER lettering, with his signature patch

views.label: Handprint
views.alt: Front of the hoodie: embroidered IL MANO wordmark and the artist's grey handprint across the chest

views.label: NFC sleeve
views.alt: Sleeve detail: vertical IL MANO tab with the metal hand button, and the MANO hem label

artistFilm.heading: One hand, *one piece.*
artistFilm.text: De La Nuez on the piece, then the moment he presses his hand into the cotton. Tap the sleeve of the finished piece and its NFC tag brings you back to this.

productionFilm.caption: Pulled by hand, layer by layer.

specs.title: Edition
specs.body: Four made, one in each size: S, M, L, XL. De La Nuez keeps three for his own collection, so one piece is available, in the size of your choice.

specs.title: Authentication
specs.body: The artist's actual handprint, applied by him. An NFC tag embedded in the sleeve opens the film documenting it.

specs.title: Also included
specs.body: Signed copy of De La Nuez's coffee-table book "High Maintenance" (Pool Boy cover). 12¼ × 12¼ in hardback, 338 pages, limited print run.

specs.title: Benefiting
specs.body: PHASE ONE Gala 2026, a 501(c)(3). Offered in the live auction, donated by Nelson De La Nuez and Il Mano Gallery.

note: Bidding closes Sat 17 Oct 2026 · 5:00 PM PDT
